historical_source.mechanics: resampFac is the smallest power of two with output_step/resampFac <= 1/50 M; rdMatchPoint[1] is floored with fmod to this high-rate grid and the ringdown helper requires an exact time-vector match.

interpretation: Integer public offsets support an actual high-rate attachment knot. Native/public differences in separately peak-anchored charts do not by themselves locate the underlying dynamics error or establish release parity.

scope.description: Retrospective grid alignment of two independently inverted public ringdowns; each waveform uses its own fitted peak chart.
known_limitations: Convergence cannot establish correctness of the equations or published model fidelity.
The adaptive prototype uses a diagnostic QNM spline with independently generated values and black-box-inferred knot metadata; this is not wholly literature-specified provenance.
Changing dt also changes the adaptive initial step and coarse/fine restart sampling; the grid check measures the complete generator's grid sensitivity.
No time, phase, amplitude, or coefficient fitting is performed.
No derivatives, batched execution, accelerators, or JAX are qualified here.
